items.title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
items.summary:
* **Title:** TurboFieldfare: M Series Macs Running 14GB Quantized Models with 2GB of RAM
* **Summary:** Developer TurboFieldfare has created a dedicated inference engine using Swift and Metal.  The engine successfully runs a 14GB quantized Gemma 4 26B model on Macs with 8GB of RAM, utilizing a memory and SSD hybrid architecture. The approach involves keeping shared layers and KV caches in RAM, and dynamically streaming loading of expert layers.  Performance testing on M2 Air and M5 Pro achieved 5-6 and 31-35 tokens/s, respectively.

items.title: Hunter-gatherers introduced fish to a mountain lake 7000 years ago
items.summary:
* **Title:** 7,000 Years Ago, Norwegian Hunters Introduced Salmon to High-Altitude Lakes, Rewriting Ecological History
* **Summary:** Researchers at the University of Oslo have confirmed that prehistoric humans introduced salmon to high-altitude lakes in Norway, using carbon dating and tree ring analysis. This discovery establishes the earliest known case of human-induced fish migration globally and demonstrates that humans possessed the ability to actively modify their environment thousands of years before the rise of agriculture.
